newsitem.title: FRANCE: Five drown in three weeks in one Algerian province.
newsitem.headline: Five drown in three weeks in one Algerian province.

text.p: Five people have drowned in the first three weeks of Algeria's official summer season -- which started on June 1 -- in the western coastal province of Tipaza, rescue services said on Monday.
But lifeguards saved 28 people in danger of drowning during the same period, the services said, quoted by the official news agency APS.
